EC1: - • Patients with known platelet dysfunction syndrome, critical thrombocytopenia (<50,000/ul), any hemodynamic instability.
EC2: - Patients with chronic medical illness (e.g. diabetes, chronic infections, [OR] and blood dyscrasias).
EC3: - Patients with local inflammatory skin disorders or active herpes infection at the site of the procedure.
EC4: - Patients on consistent use of anti-coagulants [OR] or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) within 48 hours of procedure.
EC5: - Haemoglobin level< 10 g/dl were also [NOT] excluded.
EC6: - Patients with cancer- especially hematopoietic [OR] or of bone.
EC8: - Patients with corticosteroids injection at treatment site within 1 month [OR] or systemic use of corticosteroids within 2 weeks.
